justification: GST-3562 part 3 (Captain GStack Minder's ruling of 2026-11-24 under CREW rule 15, scoped by approval a-6ec01c09edf8): the scoped review step is dropped. Deterministic no-loss replay, no paid run. lib/review-depth.ts: after a blocking fix in round 1 on a diff below full depth with a fix range of at most 150 runtime lines, loopStep plans a full pass on the range (keepReader, plus a new rangeReaders flag) instead of main's scoped pass, whose fix-check reader bin/gstack-review-dispatch left out of the manifest; planReview's full step with rangeReaders always dispatches the Red Team and, when the fix range has runtime lines, the native adversarial again even after Step 11 ran it, as main's scoped pass did. Every other full step plans the same readers as before. test/review-depth-lean.test.ts replays main's table frozen at 0408128 against this branch over the scoped-reachable grid main's GST-3562 grid never reached: docs, tests, code, risk and mixed fixtures x panels all, off and risk x light and standard depth (20 and 400 diff lines, and --depth-floor standard at 120 and 400) x fix ranges of 0, 1, 24 and 150 runtime lines x adversarialRan true and false x no numbers, unchanged numbers and changed numbers x targeted none or money x force none or security, with history fullPasses 1, last full, fixedBlocking true: 5,760 cases. 2,304 are kind g (576 each for docs, tests, code and mixed, all under panel all), where main planned a scoped pass and the branch plans a full pass; test/helpers/gst3562-replay.ts asserts per case that the full pass keeps a full-effort reader excluding nothing main's fix-check read and every other reader main dispatched (Red Team, native adversarial, outside voice, forced specialists by role, targeted), and that each specialist main dispatched is read by a branch specialist under its name or batched checklist that excludes no path main's specialist read. Forced specialists keep their paths: with rangeReaders and a force-included specialist, the batched specialist excludes no docs or outputs, as main's scoped pass dispatched each forced specialist with no exclusion. Pending Step 11 voices read the merge base on a full round 2: bin/gstack-review-dispatch pass, given --diff-base and no --adversarial-ran, stages the native adversarial and outside voice on the merge base (buildManifest's voiceBase in lib/review-pass.ts), where main's scoped pass kept them, while the Red Team and specialists read the range; once Step 11 has run they read the given --diff-base as before. 2,688 are kind a (lean-mode fix-checks already covered by GST-3562 A), and 768 (the risk fixture under panels all and risk, at full depth) plan the same as main. No case drops a reader, every case plans a full step, and none dispatches a fix-check. The existing GST-3562 A grid's counts are unchanged. ship/sections/review-army.md and ship/DRIVER.md: workflow prose only. The line #4781 added (run the scoped repeat's fix-check reader yourself beside the pass) becomes 'round 2 is always a full pass on the range, never a scoped one: every reader it plans is in the pass's manifest', and the scoped review-log row and the 'scoped is 3 too' decision line go, because nextStep no longer plans a scoped step; every reviewer brief cut from the section renders byte-identical to its pinned body (brief-bodies pins unchanged).
